notes.title: Bunny Park Spring Blossom Update!
notes.notes:
Spring is here with a new set of decorations for Bunny Park!

 Grow cherry and orange trees to feed your bunnies!
 Adopt ducks and ducklings to keep your bunnies company!
 Decorate your park with new items such as a windmill, tulips and a pond!

This seasonal event will last until June. However, spring themed decorations placed in the park during this event will stay in your park even once the event is over.

notes.title: Bunny Park Winter Wonderland update!
notes.notes:
Create your own winter wonderland during this festive event in Bunny Park!

 Add a dozen new winter decorations such as an ice fort, skating rink and festive tree!
 Grow winterberry and blueberry bushes!
 Give cute winter hats for your bunnies to wear!

This seasonal event will last until March. However, winter themed decorations placed in the park during this event will stay in your park even once the event is over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387775/ddb941930a19423e602647a7222376cc28e4ffc7.gif

notes.title: Bunny Park Cozy Autumn Update!
notes.notes:
Celebrate the fall with cozy autumn themed decorations in Bunny Park!

 Add a dozen new fall decorations such as a scarecrow, sunflower & spooky pumpkin!
 Grow pear and apple fruit trees for your bunnies!

This seasonal even will last until December. However, autumn themed decorations placed in the park during this event will stay in your park even once the event is over.

notes.title: Bug fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I've just released a small patch to fix some issues that have been reported since the launch of Bunny Park.

 Improved the butterfly AI. The butterflies don’t get stuck anymore and fly around faster.
 Added mouse camera controls. Move the camera by bringing your cursor to the edge of the screen. Rotate the camera by holding down the middle mouse button.
 Improved game performance.
 Increased the camera movement speed.

Thank you!
